title: Docs: Link ADRs to design doc and update schema
description: Update uber_design_doc.md to reference the ADRs. Add final Prisma schema incorporating all ADR decisions (auth fields, retry fields, kernel contracts). Document the processing flow with retry and one-to-many mapping.

title: LLM: Define kernel interface and canonicalKey generation
description: Kernel interface + types for observation processing, with adapters for text/url/pdf/image inputs and canonicalKey generation.

title: Complete Grafana observability setup
description:
Finish setting up Grafana Cloud observability:

## Done
- [x] Backend logging with pino + pino-loki (direct to Grafana Cloud)
- [x] Grafana Faro SDK installed for frontend
- [x] Alloy config created (optional for production)

## Remaining
- [ ] Create Faro app in Grafana Cloud and get collector URL
- [ ] Add VITE_FARO_COLLECTOR_URL to .env.local
- [ ] Test frontend logs appearing in Grafana Cloud
- [ ] Optional: Add Prometheus metrics endpoint (/metrics)
- [ ] Optional: Set up Alloy for production unified collection

## Config needed
```
VITE_FARO_COLLECTOR_URL=https://faro-collector-prod-ap-south-1.grafana.net/collect/xxx
```

title: LLM: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
description: Add retry loop (3 attempts, 5s/15s/30s backoff) in observation processing. Track processingAttempts, update lastError on failure. Classify retryable vs non-retryable errors. Mark observation FAILED after 3 attempts. Implement isRetryableError() helper (ADR-003).

title: MVP: Impact listings ingestion + curation
description: Deliver manual ingestion -> LLM extraction -> human approval -> publish read path. Stack: Vercel Express, Prisma/Postgres, React-admin. No cron/queues in MVP.

title: Admin: Observations list/show + 'Process' action
description: List observations (PENDING/DONE/FAILED), show details, add custom button to call POST /observations/:id/process with optimistic UI updates.
notes: Revise observation intake UI: single composer with radio choice (text vs upload) + URL chips; create one observation per item; simplify form.

title: Admin: Revisions review/compare + Approve
description: Custom page to view extracted JSON (and edited overlay), allow quick edits, and approve revision. Calls POST /revisions/:id/approve and updates listing pointer.

title: Admin: Listings list/show (current revision)
description: Display Listings with selected revision summary fields; show resolved payload; link to source Observation and all Revisions.

title: LLM: Define schema v1 + prompt and extractor
description: Specify JSON schema for job listing fields (title, org, location, salary, applyUrl, etc.), craft prompt/system message, implement extractor function returning extracted JSON.

title: LLM: Dev fallback + env wiring
description: If no API key, use deterministic mock extractor for local dev. Add env vars (LLM_PROVIDER, OPENAI_API_KEY) and config.

title: Storage: rawBlobRef handling + metadata
description: Storage: abstraction + Vercel Blob implementation for raw uploads (PDF/images/markdown).

title: Security/Config: Admin auth, CORS, Content-Range
description: Add simple admin auth (token/basic) for admin endpoints, enable CORS for react-admin, implement Content-Range headers for list endpoints.

title: Dev: Seed/demo data
description: Add script to insert a sample Observation (pasted job text) and run process to produce PENDING Revisions for demos.

title: Deploy: Vercel config + env + Prisma migrate
description: Configure Vercel serverless functions, set env vars (DATABASE_URL, ADMIN_TOKEN, LLM keys), and ensure Prisma migrate runs on deploy (or manual script).

title: Docs: README for MVP flows and setup
description: Add README covering data model, API endpoints, admin UI usage, env setup, and local dev instructions.

title: Prisma: Define MVP schema (Listing, Observation, Revision, enums)
description: Add Prisma models for Listing, Observation, Revision, enums and JSON fields per design doc. Include schemaVersion and optional resolved on Revision; processingStatus, processingAttempts, lastError, processedAt, createdBy, processedBy on Observation; selectedRevisionId on Listing; approvedBy, approvedAt on Revision (ADR-003, ADR-005).

title: Backlog: Cron to process PENDING observations
description: Add Vercel Cron to periodically process pending observations; secure with CRON_SECRET; small batches to fit function duration.

title: Backlog: Move processing to Vercel Workflow/Queues
description: Trigger workflow per observation; track Observation.processingStatus/attempts/workflowRunId; use cron only for reconciliation/re-drive.

title: Backlog: Apify scraping integration + webhooks
description: Add Apify actors to fetch job pages, store raw HTML/text to dataset, ingest via webhook to create Observations.

title: Backlog: Add Listing.revisionCounter for deterministic versioning
description: Add an integer counter incremented in transaction when creating revisions; avoid MAX(version)+1 races.

title: Backlog: Store diff artifact per Revision
description: Compute and store human-friendly diff between extracted vs edited/resolved to aid reviews and auditing.

title: Public API: Expose listings for consumer site
description: Read-only endpoints for published listings, with pagination and filters; uses selectedRevision resolved payload.

title: API: Bulk create observations (one per item)
description: Add POST /api/observations/bulk to accept mixed inputs (text, urls, files) and create one Observation per item.

title: Content fetcher: Readability (URL -> markdown) behind interface
description: Implement ContentFetcher interface with Readability + turndown for URL ingestion. Keep swappable for Apify crawler later.

title: Admin: Unified intake composer (text/url/files)
description: Replace observation form with a single composer that accepts paste text, URL chips, and multi-file upload; on submit create one observation per item via bulk endpoint.

title: Prisma: Generate initial migration and configure Postgres connection
description: Create migration for MVP schema and wire DATABASE_URL. Add Prisma client generation in build/dev scripts.
notes: Migration applied successfully using DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres; Prisma client generated.

title: API: POST /observations (create)
description: Accept pasted text or blob reference with metadata; insert Observation with processingStatus=PENDING.

title: API: POST /observations/:id/process (LLM extraction)
description: Load Observation, run LLM to extract schemaVersion=1 JSON, create one or more PENDING Revisions linked to a Listing, mark Observation DONE/FAILED.

title: API: POST /revisions/:id/approve (publish)
description: Set Revision.status=APPROVED, set Listing.selectedRevisionId, compute and store resolved JSON (merge edited over extracted).

title: API: GET /listings/:id (read current)
description: Return selected revision payload: resolved ?? edited ?? extracted, plus Listing identity fields. Include for public and admin read paths.

title: API: Admin list endpoints (+ Content-Range)
description: Implement REST endpoints compatible with react-admin: list/paginate/sort for Observations, Revisions (filter by status=PENDING), Listings. Return Content-Range and enable CORS.

title: Admin: React-admin setup + dataProvider
description: Initialize react-admin app, wire dataProvider to Express API, enable CORS, verify pagination headers.

title: Auth: Clerk integration setup
description: Install @clerk/nextjs and @clerk/express. Add ClerkProvider to admin UI layout. Add requireAuth middleware for API routes. Configure Clerk app and environment variables. Store userId in Observation.createdBy/processedBy and Revision.approvedBy (ADR-005).
